context: A private follow-up to the quarterly review. The boss gives more honest one-on-one feedback to Yuki.
purpose: workplace one-on-one — formal authority offering more candid mentorship

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 佐藤さん、改めて、今期の評価について。
lines.en: Sato, again, about this quarter's evaluation.
lines.style: Boss measured formal authority opener, the professional weight held respectfully, soft real focus threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、よろしくお願いします。
lines.style: Office woman warm formal respectful receiving, the careful composure audible, soft real attention threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 結果は素晴らしかった。期待以上だった。
lines.en: The results were splendid. Beyond expectations.
lines.style: Boss measured warm professional praise, the careful weight of real recognition audible, soft real respect threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。
lines.style: Office woman warm sincere brief formal, the gentle real composure audible, soft real composure threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来年は、もう少し主体的に動いてほしい。
lines.en: Next year, I'd like you to act more independently.
lines.style: Boss measured warm careful direction-setting, the professional honest guidance audible, soft real respect threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 主体的に、ですか。具体的には？
lines.style: Office woman warm professional clarifying inquiry, the careful real engagement audible, soft real composure threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 会議で、もっと意見を出してほしい。
lines.en: In meetings, voice your opinions more.
lines.style: Boss measured warm specific direction, the professional candor audible, soft real respect threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: わかりました。意識して、努力します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll be conscious of it and try.
lines.style: Office woman warm sincere committed acceptance, the gentle real composed-promise audible, soft real composure throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 期待してる。何かあれば相談してほしい。
lines.en: I'm counting on you. If anything, please consult me.
lines.style: Boss measured warm closing offer, the professional door-opening audible, soft real respect threading throughout delivery throughout.
